name: Deluxe Sea View
description: The largest room in the house. An extra-large double bed, a private kitchenette, and a terrace where the sea fills the horizon from your first cup of the day.

name: Garden Double
description: Tucked behind the garden, quieter and cooler. A double bed, a private terrace opening onto the greenery, and a kitchenette for your own unhurried rhythm.

name: Double Sea View
description: Wake up to the water. A double room with a sea-view terrace, a private kitchenette for slow mornings, and a bathroom all to yourself.

name: Standard Queen
description: One of the most spacious rooms in the house. A double bed, a full private kitchenette, and a quiet courtyard terrace for reading or afternoon rest.

name: Twin Room
description: Two single beds, a balcony and a private kitchenette. The right room for friends travelling together who want their own space without paying double.

name: Economy Twin
description: The most honest room in the house. Two single beds, a courtyard terrace, a private kitchenette, everything you need, nothing you don't.
